    threshold = case["threshold"]
    calls = case["calls"]
    
    if not isinstance(calls, list):
        raise ValueError("calls must be a list")
    
    accepted_call_ids = []
    diagnostics = []
    
    for call in calls:
        for field in ("call_id", "loss_without_call", "loss_with_call", "prediction_tokens", "parseable"):
            if field not in call:
                raise ValueError(f"Missing required field: {field}")
        
        call_id = call["call_id"]
        loss_without = call["loss_without_call"]
        loss_with = call["loss_with_call"]
        tokens = call["prediction_tokens"]
        parseable = call["parseable"]
        
        if not isinstance(tokens, (int, float)) or tokens < 1:
            raise ValueError(f"prediction_tokens must be >= 1 for call {call_id}")
        
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        normalized_gain = gain / max(tokens, 1)
        
        accepted = bool(parseable) and (normalized_gain >= threshold)
        
        diagnostics.append({
            "call_id": call_id,
            "accepted": accepted,
            "normalized_gain": normalized_gain
        })
        
        if accepted:
            accepted_call_ids.append(call_id)
    
    return {
        "accepted_call_ids": accepted_call_ids,
        "diagnostics": diagnostics
    }
